question: The average monthly income of P and Q is Rs. 5,050. The average monthly income of Q and R is Rs. 6,250 and the average monthly income of P and R is Rs. 5,200. The monthly income of P (in Rs.) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of (P+Q), (Q+R), and (P+R) = 2 × (P+Q+R).

P + Q = 5050 × 2 = 10100

Q + R = 6250 × 2 = 12500

P + R = 5200 × 2 = 10400

P = [(P+Q) + (P+R) − (Q+R)] ÷ 2 = [10100 + 10400 − 12500] ÷ 2 = 8000 ÷ 2 = 4000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39d5b3812ae34715ad43109e86adcafd37a60eec4e3b37cac69c69c39404b69a.png] 

**Given:** Average of **P and Q** = ₹5,050; Average of **Q and R** = ₹6,250; Average of **P and R** = ₹5,200.

**Formula Used:** Total Sum = Average × Number of entities.

⇒ P + Q = 5050 × 2 = 10100 --- (i)

⇒ Q + R = 6250 × 2 = 12500 --- (ii)

⇒ P + R = 5200 × 2 = 10400 --- (iii)

⇒ Adding (i), (ii), and (iii): 2(P + Q + R) = 10100 + 12500 + 10400 = 33000

⇒ P + Q + R = 33000 ÷ 2 = 16500

⇒ Monthly income of P = (P + Q + R) − (Q + R) = 16500 − 12500

⇒ P = 4000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Income Formula

Average = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations). In this case, Sum = Average × 2.

Cyclic Sums

For equations of type A+B, B+C, and C+A, the value of A = [(A+B) + (C+A) − (B+C)] ÷ 2.

Combined Average

The average of all three (P, Q, R) is the sum of the three pair-averages divided by 3, which is 16500 ÷ 3 = ₹5,500.
